activity.role: Mongol imperial general and field commander
activity.notes: Stephen Pow and Jingjing Liao's source-critical study translates Subutai's Yuan Shi biographies and reconstructs his military career. ATLAS uses c. 1211-1247 only as a bounded representative military-activity window, from his early Jin-war service through the final Song campaign, rather than treating his lifespan as a continuous career rail; both endpoints remain approximate at year granularity.

sources.title: Subutai: Sorting Fact from Fiction Surrounding the Mongol Empire’s Greatest General (With Translations of Subutai’s Two Biographies in the Yuan Shi)
sources.citation_text: Stephen Pow and Jingjing Liao provide a source-critical reconstruction of Subutai's military career together with English translations of his biographies in Yuan Shi chapters 121 and 122.
sources.locator: Journal of Chinese Military History 7.1 (2018), 37-76; DOI 10.1163/22127453-12341323
